mapper.sql: stat_id, proto_type, entrance_id, c2s_pkt_num, s2c_pkt_num, c2s_byte_len, s2c_byte_len, stat_time
mapper.select: SELECT proto_type protoType, ( SUM(c2s_pkt_num) + SUM(s2c_pkt_num) + SUM(c2s_byte_len) + SUM(s2c_byte_len)) count, ( SUM(c2s_pkt_num) + SUM(s2c_pkt_num)) pktNum, ( SUM(c2s_byte_len) + SUM(s2c_byte_len)) byteLen FROM galaxy.traffic_protocol_statistic WHERE proto_type != 0 AND stat_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) GROUP BY proto_type ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 0, 10
